name: John Moolenaar
committees: House Select Committee on the CCP (Chairman)
stance: Frames AI-chip export-control enforcement as protecting both U.S. national security and AI leadership against the CCP; the Chip Security Act grew out of his committee's DeepSeek report.

statements.text: Original co-lead of the bipartisan Chip Security Act, which grew out of his Select Committee's report on DeepSeek.
This bipartisan bill closes those gaps with real safeguards to keep our most advanced chips out of the wrong hands.
